draft.emotion: measured and deliberate, focusing on the lack of urgency
notes: For arriving late, มาช้า means arriving later than expected or after others, whereas มาสาย means late for a fixed schedule such as work or school (chiefly in the morning).
Reduplicated as ช้าๆ (/tɕʰáː.tɕʰáː/) to mean 'slowly', e.g. พูดช้าๆ (speak slowly).
